import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Complex Polynomial LinearMap FiniteDimensional Module Module.End
open scoped BigOperators

theorem finite_iterated_neg_sum_transport {ι V : Type*} [Fintype ι] [AddCommGroup V]
    (n : ℕ) (f : ι → V) :
    Finset.univ.sum (fun i => Nat.rec (fun x : V => x)
      (fun _ g x => -g x) n (f i)) =
      if n % 2 = 0 then Finset.univ.sum f else -Finset.univ.sum f := by
  induction n generalizing f with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    try simp only [Function.iterate_succ', Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ih]
    by_cases h : n % 2 = 0
    · have h' : ¬ (n + 1) % 2 = 0 := by omega
      rw [if_pos h, if_neg h']
    · have h' : (n + 1) % 2 = 0 := by omega
      rw [if_neg h, if_pos h', neg_neg]
